# Documentation Protocol

Where information goes: `AGENTS.md` §5. Unsure → `QUESTIONS`. Never duplicate a fact across levels.

## docs/codebase/*.md
- Terse, factual, evergreen. No "as of US-007" in the prose.
- A US changed it → one line in the file's `## History`: `- YYYY-MM-DD — US-XXX: <change>`.
- `WORKFLOW.md` is written by the `onboard` skill and changed only on a user request.

## docs/us/US-*.md
- Section order and ownership: `.github/instructions/us-frontmatter.instructions.md`. Write only your section.
- `INDEX.md` is generated by the `refresh-index` skill, never by hand.

## docs/adr/
- `NNNN-kebab-slug.md`, next free number, from `0000-template.md`, linked in the US `related-adrs`.
- Status `proposed → accepted | rejected | superseded`. The architect writes it `proposed`; it becomes `accepted` only after a user `DECISION`.
- Only for cross-cutting, hard-to-reverse decisions. No ADR for naming or file location.
